label: Standard (7 Loops)
description: Standard seven belt loops space evenly around the waistband to carry a belt securely, the default on most casual and odd trousers. The loops let a belt do the holding while keeping the trouser anchored at common stress points. Seven is the typical full complement for a balanced layout.
